steps.npc: Nilsal, iknami. Thank you for saving my life in that cave.
After what happened, I've decided to make some changes in my life. First up is less work. Next is more drinking!
Well, not too much more. I wouldn't want to become known for it. I just plan to relax and enjoy myself a bit more.

steps.player: Well, I can't blame you for that. All the best.
